purpose: Laravel platform for professional resume, portfolio and service-page creation, with subscription and profile administration.
stack: PHP 8.2, Laravel 11, Blade, QR code packages, payment packages
subtitle: Turn experience and projects into a professional online presence.
summary: Professional profiles, resumes, portfolios, work history, services, testimonials, publishing and subscription packages.
overview: The source summary describes a Laravel 11 platform for resume and professional portfolio management, with user and admin workflows. Unlike the EzeAD Jobs codebase, it centers on authoring profiles and showcasing work instead of employer job listings.
focus: Distinct from the existing employment and quiz products: it is a professional identity and portfolio builder.
